episode_title: Government Funding Pressure On Iran War, National Security & Tech, Iowa Detonation
script_en: Government Funding Pressure On Iran War, National Security & Tech, Iowa Detonation.
Democrats are weighing whether to use the government funding deadline to cut off money for the war in Iran, exposing divisions over how quickly the party should act.
The Trump administration approved sales of advanced U.S.
chips to Chinese companies, including some the Pentagon has linked to China’s military, fueling a debate over whether those sales help America compete or create new security risks.
The Army delayed plans to destroy thousands of pounds of unstable bomb-making material in Iowa after public pressure and a lawsuit, even as officials warn colder weather could make it more dangerous.
